"""Bind actual reviewed conclusions,tables and native galleries into the report."""
import html
import re
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert notes.is_file() and len(notes.read_text())>300
assert read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json')['primary_figures_covered']==72
assert read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status']=='pass'
tables=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json');figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
assert len(tables['cells'])==205 and figures['all_RGB_channels_checked']==50764800
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')
assert execution['head_calls']==5412 and execution['recorded_owner_count']==11
text='# Distant frequency context: V161 final quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and immutable sources](results/v161-harmonic-context-final-v1.json) · '
text+='[Native pixels, source ROIs, conditioning, exposure and checkpoint hashes](images/v161-harmonic-context-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Response and actual blank error\n\n'
text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Response1 means the exact constructed mesh amplitude. Blank error measures actual target error; added blank RMS measures displacement from V143.\n\n'+tables['sections']['mesh']+'\n'
text+='## Quiet neighbors and coarse fields\n\n'+tables['sections']['quiet']+'\n'
dc=read(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
text+='Quiet bias is averaged per RGB channel before its Euclidean RMS. The independent pixel audit verifies total squared = spatial squared + DC squared per case; means of RMS values do not share that identity.\n\n'
text+='| Prior | Method | Quiet DC RMS DN16 |\n| --- | --- | ---: |\n'
for item in dc['groups']:
    text+=f"| {item['prior']} | {item['method']} | {item['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']:.6f} |\n"
text+='\n'+tables['sections']['flat']+'\n'
text+='## Natural detail and ADC controls\n\n'+tables['sections']['photo']+'\n'+tables['sections']['ADC']+'\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='Every cell is native 160×160; crop pixels are never resized. All RAW methods within each board share source coordinates, camera display transform, exposure and contrast. JPEG cells retain native sRGB8 without exposure/contrast changes. Both final raw/EMA endpoints of both heads are shown, with five retained V156/V157/V158/V159/V160 ordinary columns.\n\n'
text+='The main scene is DSCF3879 ISO6400 versus DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6. The fine cab mesh uses DSCF3842 versus DSCF3835 and both camera JPEGs. Aperture, shutter, moving subjects and processing differ: ISO100 views are qualitative references, not exact GT. All30 real score rows stay unscored.\n\n'
categories=[('mesh','Mesh and exact absence'),('mixed-quiet','Quiet neighbors beside edges'),
    ('flat','Standalone flats and slopes'),('photo','Natural photographic detail'),('real','Protected real GFX scenes')]
for kind,title in categories:
    text+=f'### {title}\n\n'
    for item in figures['images']:
        if 'triplet_source_board' in item or item['case']['kind']!=kind:continue
        name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
        text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, RAW exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
        text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}, native comparison](images/v161-harmonic-context-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='### Noisy, restored, exact constructed GT triplets\n\n'
for item in figures['images']:
    if 'triplet_source_board' not in item:continue
    name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
    text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}; {item['panels'][1]['label']}; native triplet](images/v161-harmonic-context-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='## Training, architecture and validation\n\n'
text+='The candidate has 124,397 parameters/46 tensors versus 117,677/45 in the control. It adds a zero-initialized bias-free210→32 projection of five transported 42-channel frequency descriptors: twice frequency and four half-frequency alias branches. Half-bin interpolation wraps on the full descriptor map, including alias-branch boundaries. Common initialization, cached 1,000 B4 batches, pair-response weight 1, all RGB/gradient/local/DC/delivered spectral losses, AdamW/clipping and EMA clocks are fixed. The comparison includes 6,720 extra parameters and compute. Targets/pair fields never enter inference.\n\n'
text+='The control exactly reproduces every V160 paired-response trace row and final raw/EMA/Adam state; all 1,644 actual control predictions replay byte-exact before archive storage is reused. The candidate retains 1,644 new arrays externally. All 87 prior neural source files remain unchanged; one new module adds the adapter. Older comparator columns mix architecture/loss/data changes.\n\n'
text+='The reused V160 cache contains 4,000 frames: 1,382 present/background pairs and 1,236 ordinary frames, based on 2,618 scene/patch instances. Its 486 photo pairs visit 268 free-photo IDs; 234 reduce contrast and 245 use reviewed ROIs. Geometry precedes area 2 after bin 4;zero optical blur. All 18 held-out source IDs and protected captures/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded. Pair units use pre-ADC shot-increment RMS floored at 16 DN16;shared read draws cancel before ADC, and RGB losses remain necessary. No new source construction, parent/DINO calls or sensor draws occur in V161. [V160 construction evidence](paired-response.md) retains its original accounting failure and explicit 23-batch adoption.\n\n'
text+='139 CPU checks pass, including 16 new independent coordinate/input-adjoint, half-branch boundary, nonzero old-head embedding, per-image independence, all 46 tensor-gradient and constant-control checks. Genuine 8+2 model/EMA/Adam/RNG restoration passes;the first 10 complete smoke/train rows match exactly. CUDA zero-adapter parity covers 28 contexts / 56 calls and all CFAs/native 256/384/512/768. Four strict final CPU loads and 91 finite Adam states at 1,000 pass. All 1,000 control trace rows match V160.\n\n'
routing=read(root/'training-routing-summary-v1.json')
for item in routing['groups']:
    if item['ADC_only']:continue
    text+=f"`{item['arm']}`: {item['norms_over_one']}/{item['batches']} supervised batches clip; pre-clip norm median {item['norm_median']:.6f}, maximum {item['norm_maximum']:.6f}.\n\n"
text+='The 100 zero-gradient ADC batches advance Adam/EMA clocks. Gradient norms describe optimization pressure; they do not isolate the cause of a quality change.\n\n'
audit=read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"The independent audit checks {audit['scalar_checks']:,} scalars across 4,686 rows and {audit['Decimal_reductions']} Decimal reductions; maximum scalar difference is{audit['maximum_scalar_difference']:.3g}. All 72 native images / 24 triplets were actually viewed in 18 original-detail sheets;50,764,800 RGB channels were independently checked.\n\n"
text+='Actual scientific work is 5,412 head calls: 56 parity, 20 discarded smoke, 2,000 training, 3,288 main review and 48 context-removal calls. These evaluate 11,472 head images. There are 1,668 new external arrays: 1,644 main candidate outputs plus 24 context-off outputs. The main control and 24 diagnostic on outputs are actual exact replays. All 11 original owners are terminal;zero scientific stage failures/full-training restarts. All new work preserves 60/156 GiB local/external reserves plus 0.5 GiB projected margin. Originals and `/mnt/dataz` are unused.\n\n'
text+='## Trained context contribution\n\n'
text+='The fixed 12-case/raw-EMA diagnostic makes 48 actual calls. Zeroing only the new adapter and restoring it leaves direct RGB corrections exact;active outputs replay the main archive byte-exact. Values below measure output displacement. They do not measure improved accuracy, isolate changed training dynamics or prove false-detail suppression. Independent ISO100 references remain qualitative.\n\n'
text+='| Endpoint | Fixed case | On/off RMS DN16 | Maximum absolute DN16 |\n| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |\n'
for r in read(root/'context-removal-result-v1.json')['records']:
    text+=f"| {r['endpoint']} | {r['id']} | {r['effect_RMS_DN16']:.8f} | {r['effect_maximum_abs_DN16']:.8f} |\n"
text+='\n[Original protocol](results/v161-harmonic-context-v1/original-protocol.md) · [Immutable preparation](results/v161-harmonic-context-preparation-v1.json) · [Independent publication verification](results/v161-harmonic-context-publication-verification-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Photographic credits\n\nDerived native targets/crops retain the respective source licenses; transformations include linearization, area binning and exposure/contrast changes. Source IDs and ROIs are in the manifest.\n\n| Source | Author | License |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n'
credits={}
for case in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']:
    if case['kind']=='photo':
        credit=case['source']
        while 'author' not in credit:credit=credit['source']
        credits[credit['sha1']]=credit
assert len(credits)==18
for s in credits.values():
    author=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]*>','',s['author'])).replace('|','\\|').replace('\n',' ')
    text+=f"| [{s['title']}]({s['page_url']}) | {author} | [{s['license']}]({s['license_url']}) |\n"
text+='\n## Fixed component checkpoints\n\n'
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    text+=f"- `{label}`: `{read(binding['path'])['export']['sha256']}`.\n"
target=repo/'docs/harmonic-frequency-context.md';target.write_text(text)
receipt=root/'human-report-builder-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'built-from-actually-reviewed-notes-and-audited-tables','report':ref(target),'notes':ref(notes),
    'table_bindings':ref(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Built actual final quality report with205 score cells,10 quiet-DC cells and72 native images')
